candidates.class: Modern synthetic lexical notebook: a finite learned common-word table plus literal writing for everything else, with visible positional additions.
candidates.actual_hand_action: Recognize a frequent source word, consult its one learned row, and copy that row's host and listed optional fields; add only the separately fixed visible record/line fields. Otherwise write the explicit literal escape and the source spelling. Reverse-reading needs the same fixed lexical key, hand convention and visible layout rules.
candidates.paid_cost: 384 source-type/code correspondences. B2 additionally exposes32 unequal families,24 declared construction variants,11 listed exceptions and six S2 family variants; these are materialized in one384-row table. They do not reduce to a free universal semantic primitive inventory.
candidates.historical_limit: The input is a historical medical graphematic source, but the384-row alphabet/table and rendering rules are modern authored controls. 'Human-grown' is not historical attestation.
candidates.important_distinction: A shared finite lexical key is a legitimate paid dictionary. It must not be confused with a per-message copy of the expected plaintext. Large ordinary learned vocabularies are not rejected merely for being large.
candidates.remaining_limit: GDT171's literal mechanism is UTF-8/base19; GDT172/173 instead write w followed by unchanged source graphematic text. The cited contract does not provide the required modern22-working-sign-only fallback for every such source sign. No new source inventory was read to invent that carrier.
candidates.later_stop: GDT174 records several coordinates outside the frozen control envelope and explicitly warns that matching a few diagnostic directions does not identify native architecture. It does not prove every lexical notation impossible.

closest_later_complete_writer.retained: A later fully paid22-sign503-word dictionary and literal fallback already preserve all complete source messages but fail their full frozen screen. This does not literally test the old384-row, layout-conditioned control; it prevents presenting generic table+literal completion as new progress.

candidates.smallest_new_decision_if_revisited: A public-table-only manual readback could test hand usability, but would not reopen its diagnostic/native limitations. It would first need a prospectively complete22-sign literal/line contract; constructing that now would be a new writer, not a missing lookup search.
candidates.selection: Not selected. No old table regenerated or fitted, no new literal carrier added.

candidates.class: Ordinary-language anaphoric shorthand: retain the first full argument mention and shorten later mentions.
candidates.actual_rule: Inside one already bounded analyst card and separately by its supplied argument-root identity, keep the first full phrase; render later masculine mentions as ihn, feminine/plural mentions as sie, and the registered repeated masculine coordinate as beide.
candidates.paid_cost_in_old_experiment: Twenty pre-existing owner/form cells, local card boundaries and roots, plus an expansion record containing every replaced original fragment, root, form class and source/target span. The report explicitly preserves the inherited working edition rather than recovering native semantics.
candidates.precise_positive: The old exact roundtrip from that stored expansion channel is valid engineering evidence. It is not invalidated by this review.
candidates.precise_limit: That roundtrip alone does not establish that a reader supplied only the shortened written message can reconstruct every referent. The per-message expansion record must not become an invisible reading aid in a new human writer.

candidates.hand_action: A reader who has learned the source note vocabulary and relative-position conventions can expand those attested notes. Learning a complete clause abbreviation is a real lexicon entry, not a derived meaning free of cost.
candidates.access_limit: No new image, source page or primitive inventory was acquired. This review does not repeat the earlier source-access search.
candidates.full_writer_limit: The specific retained examples are not a complete productive channel for open unknown names and ordinary source sentences under the22-working-sign restriction. A graph simplification that deletes detached relative position would already erase an attested contrast.
candidates.retained_followups: The related mixed-FST work is extensively executed:613 scope/coverage infeasibility,614 generator infeasibility, and616's original NO_JOINT_CHILD_FEASIBLE_BINDING remain. The later616 diagnostic relaxation PASS is not a successful original decoder.
candidates.exact_remaining_unknown: A complete paid conventional system could be historically plausible, but these particular retained source pairs do not determine its full source-to-note grammar. No new native teaching-pair domain or 22-sign transcription is supplied.
candidates.selection: Keep the existing source evidence and incomplete raw card. No new decoder, enlarged vocabulary, primitive table or duplicate idea is selected.

main_selection_conclusion: None of these three reviewed contracts supplies a new complete22-sign human writer ready for another meaningful manual reading. The useful distinction is between a legitimate shared lexical key, a per-message reconstruction sidecar, and an attested but partial shorthand inventory. This is not exhaustion of all raw ideas or a prohibition on learned vocabulary.
useful_next_requirement: Any next hand trial should give the reader the complete public rule/key and written message, but not per-occurrence plaintext roots, source spans or expected fragments. It must state whether it recovers exact spelling, a declared analysis, or merely a restricted note meaning. Existing successful954/956/958 hand trials already use this separation; repeating mere lookup reversibility would add little.
